sections.label: Head
sections.text: Congestion to head ; face purple red.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Pains from lachrymal duct around eye to
temple, from inner canthus across brows to ear. Se-
vere shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running
from inner to outer canthus in the bone. Redness of
whole eye. Lids granulated; canthi and lids red.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Pressive sensation, as from heavy spectacles.
Pain about root, extending into bones on each side.
[Aur.; Kal. hyd.]

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Stringy mucus passed through posterior
nares into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat; must
rinse the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Prepuce swollen ; warts on it which bleed
easily ; testicles enlarged ; buboes ; angry-looking
chancres. Syphilides, squamous and vesicular.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Leucorrhcea, Feeling pf pressure in
vagina.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in forearm from elbow down, in-
cluding hands. Pain in long bones when barometer
lowers; coldness of joints.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
V cry fiery-red looking ulc'^rs. Nodes on shin-
bones. Buboes. Condyloma, easily bleeding.
